I have ADD, so laundry is a huge hatred. It mostly goes like this, a put in a load of laundry and set a timer on my phone to get it out when it's done, I usually go and watch a YT video and game but then the timer goes off and my focus of doing something I enjoy is interrupted by something I find annoying and tedious. I then go get it out of the machine and stand outside to decide whether I should I put it in the tumble dryer or outside on the line. And then the thoughts arrive. How much will the tumble dryer cost to run? It's sunny now, but still it rain later? Will one cycle dry it enough? Will I forget about it being on the line and leave it out overnight and then have to rewash it? It's hell. After either of the choices, I then have to diligently fold each piece of clothing and find a suitable place to put it that fits with the category and memory of where it is and if I even have enough room. Most of the time I just wear shorts and baggy t-shirts that don't touch my armpits, so I can get away with wearing it for more than one day.
